matter: Aurora Grid Systems LLC v. Heltex Energy Corp. (fictional)
setDescription: Claim set A: asserted claims as proposed-construed (opening brief). Set B: same claims after examiner amendment in parallel reexam.
setA:
1. A thermal management system for a battery module, the system comprising:
a coolant channel defined through a stack of prismatic cells;
a temperature sensor array disposed on at least two faces of the stack;
a controller configured to modulate coolant flow based on the temperature sensor array; and
a pressure-relief valve in fluid communication with the coolant channel.
2. The system of claim 1, wherein the coolant is a dielectric fluid.
3. The system of claim 1, wherein the controller derates the stack when any sensor exceeds a threshold; and wherein the derating persists for at least five minutes.
setB:
1. A thermal management system for a battery module, the system comprising:
a coolant channel defined through a stack of prismatic cells;
a temperature sensor array disposed on at least two faces of the stack;
a controller configured to modulate coolant flow based on the temperature sensor array and a discharge threshold; and
a pressure-relief valve in fluid communication with the coolant channel.
2. The system of claim 1, wherein the coolant is a dielectric fluid and includes a corrosion inhibitor.
4. The system of claim 1, wherein the pressure-relief valve opens at a cracking pressure below 3 bar.
